verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed Square serves an llms.txt at developer.squareup.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, a curated 'Square Developer Platform' index). Square also publishes an llms-full.txt carrying full doc content, such as the Catalog API nested-modifier guide, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: the per-page markdown docs variant (docs.md returned 404), and no independent account of agents actually using these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://developer.squareup.com/llms.txt # Square Developer Platform
Learn how to nest modifier lists under modifiers with the Catalog API to build multi-step customization flows, and how to read and search the modifier tree.
